pages.title: Cancellation & Refund Policy
pages.subtitle: For bookings made directly with YES HOTELS (website, phone or front desk)
pages.description:
1. Cancelling your booking
You can cancel from My Bookings on this website, or by calling us on +91 87698 28787.

2. Cancellation charges
• 48 hours or more before check-in: free cancellation. Anything you paid is refunded in full.
• Between 24 and 48 hours before check-in: 50% of the booking total is charged.
• Less than 24 hours before check-in, or no-show: 100% of the booking total is charged.
Check-in time is 12:00 PM (noon) on the arrival date.

3. Refunds
Refunds are made to the original mode of payment. Online payments are usually credited within 5–7 working days, depending on your bank. Cash payments are refunded at the front desk.

4. Changes
To change your dates or number of guests, use "Request a change" in My Bookings or call us. Changes depend on availability and may change the price.

5. Leaving early
If you check out before your booked check-out date, the nights you do not stay are taken off your bill.

6. Bookings made through other websites
Bookings made on MakeMyTrip, Booking.com, Agoda, Trip.com, Expedia or Bag2Bag follow that website's cancellation policy. Please cancel through the same website.

7. Emergencies
In a genuine emergency, please call us — the front desk may waive the cancellation charge.

pages.title: Terms & Conditions
pages.subtitle: YES HOTELS, Hosa Road Junction, Bengaluru
pages.description:
These terms apply to stays and bookings at YES HOTELS, 2nd Floor, Building No. 51 / A51, Khata No. 749, Hosur Main Road, Hosa Road Junction, Parappana Agrahara, Begur, Electronic City, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560100.

1. Check-in and check-out
Check-in is from 12:00 PM (noon) to 11:30 PM; check-out is by 11:00 AM. Early check-in and late check-out depend on availability and may be charged.

2. Identification
Every guest must show a valid government photo ID at check-in, as required by law. Foreign nationals must show a passport and valid visa; their details are reported to the authorities as required (Form C).

3. Rates, taxes and payment
Room rates are per room per night. GST is charged as per law and shown separately on your bill. Extra persons, extra beds, early check-in, laundry, food and other services are charged as shown on your bill. The full bill must be settled at check-out.

4. Hourly, weekly and monthly stays
Hourly (day-use), weekly and monthly stays are available at the rates quoted at the time of booking.

5. Cancellation
See our Cancellation & Refund Policy.

6. Hotel property
Guests are responsible for any damage to hotel property caused during their stay, and the cost may be added to the bill.

7. Valuables
Please keep valuables with you. The hotel is not responsible for loss of items not handed to the front desk for safekeeping.

8. Right of admission
The hotel may refuse or end a stay for behaviour that is unlawful or unsafe, or that disturbs other guests.

9. Changes to these terms
We may update these terms; the version on this page at the time of your booking applies.

10. Law and jurisdiction
These terms are governed by the laws of India. Disputes are subject to the jurisdiction of the courts in Bengaluru.

Questions: call +91 87698 28787.

pages.title: Privacy Policy
pages.subtitle: How YES HOTELS uses your information
pages.description:
1. What we collect
• Booking details: name, phone, email, dates, guests and room.
• At check-in, as required by law: ID proof and address; for foreign nationals, passport and visa details.
• Billing: your bill, payments and refunds. Online payments are handled by our payment provider; we do not store your card details.
• Messages you send us through the website chat or contact form.
• If you create an account: your login details and saved preferences.

2. Why we use it
To take and manage your booking, check you in as the law requires, issue bills and GST invoices, answer your questions, and keep the hotel's legally required records.

3. Who we share it with
We do not sell your information. We share it only where needed: with the authorities when the law requires (for example, Form C for foreign guests), with our payment provider to process payments, and with the booking website you used, if you booked through one.

4. How long we keep it
We keep registration and billing records for as long as the law requires (tax and guest-register rules), and other information only as long as it is needed.

5. Security
Access to guest information is limited to hotel staff who need it, and every access to sensitive records is logged.

6. Your choices
You can ask to see or correct your information, or to delete what we are not required by law to keep. Call +91 87698 28787 or ask at the front desk.

7. Changes
We may update this policy; the latest version is always on this page.
